name: Kinematics of Mechanisms
summary: Analysis and synthesis of linkages, cams and gear trains that produce a desired motion.

topics.name: Links, joints, kinematic chains and mechanism classification
Grashof condition, four-bar linkage behaviour and inversions
Position analysis of linkages (graphical, vector-loop, complex-number methods)
Velocity analysis and instant centres (Kennedy's theorem)
Slider-crank, quick-return and other common mechanisms
Linkage synthesis: function, path and motion generation (graphical and Freudenstein methods)
Cam design: follower motions, SVAJ diagrams and cam-profile synthesis
Gear-train kinematics: simple, compound, reverted and epicyclic trains
Intermittent-motion mechanisms: Geneva wheels and ratchets
